metadata.method_name: Directional Consensus (DC), freeze-then-confirm on fresh NL->FOL data
metadata.description: Gold-free, text-blind faithfulness score: reliability-weighted share of peer formalizations that are solver-equivalent under lexical-free alignment. Config frozen on 700 dev sentences before fresh labels; tested on 450 fresh sentences x 9 systems under panel (L3) and audited-solver (L1) labels.
